hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
echo "HOST=$HOPSWORKS_HOST"; echo "KEY set: ${HOPSWORKS_API_KEY:+yes}"; python -c "import hopsworks; print('hopsworks', hopsworks.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -3

hops fg list 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===CONTEXT==="; hops context 2>&1 | head -30

  --features "account_id:string:Account id,home_lat:double,home_lon:double,base_score:double" \
  --description "Stored account profiles" 2>&1 | tail -5

  --description "Scoring requests" 2>&1 | tail -5
hops fg insert profiles --version 1 --file data/profiles.csv 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert requests --version 1 --file data/requests.csv 2>&1 | tail -8

hops fg delete requests --version 1 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "---recreate---"; hops fg create requests --version 1 --primary-key request_id \
  --features "request_id:string,account_id:string,request_lat:double,request_lon:double,requested_at:string" \
  --description "Scoring requests" 2>&1 | tail -3
printf 'y\n' | hops fg delete requests --version 1 2>&1 | tail -3

hops fg create requests --version 1 --primary-key request_id \
  --features "request_id:string,account_id:string,request_lat:double,request_lon:double,requested_at:string" \
  --description "Scoring requests" 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo "---insert---" && hops fg insert requests --version 1 --file data/requests.csv 2>&1 | tail -5

hops sql --json "SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6) AS distance_deg, ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1*ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6),6) AS score FROM requests_1 r JOIN profiles_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id ORDER BY r.request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --json "SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6) AS distance_deg, ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1*ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6),6) AS score FROM requests_1 r JOIN profiles_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id ORDER BY r.request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabd535f9_featurestore --catalog hive --json "SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6) AS distance_deg, ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1*ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6),6) AS score FROM requests_1 r JOIN profiles_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id ORDER BY r.request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Closing | grep -v Connection | grep -v Logged | grep -v Warning | grep -v compatib | grep -v "pip install"

hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpabd535f9_featurestore --catalog delta --json "SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6) AS distance_deg, ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1*ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat,2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon,2)),6),6) AS score FROM requests_1 r JOIN profiles_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id ORDER BY r.request_id LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v Closing | grep -v Connection | grep -v Logged | grep -v Warning | grep -v compatib | grep -v "pip install"
